profiled_first_run_durations_us.note: These are first profiled runs, not the warm bench samples; they do not by themselves explain the 4x warm delta.

observations: 081900Z is ~4x faster (p50 2.56-2.70 ms) than 074700Z (10.07-10.97 ms) and the 095000Z single-session check (p50 11.07 ms).
The two ~10-11 ms observations come from different methods/runs; the 2.56-2.70 ms value is the outlier in the available dataset.
No GPU clock, power, temperature or display/RDP session telemetry was recorded with any benchmark.
The PR #8 report's statement that GPU clock/thermal state caused the difference is a hypothesis, not measured evidence.

candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: GPU core/memory clock and power-state difference (idle vs boosted)
display/RDP session or frame-pacing state affects DML submission
DML pipeline/shader cache warm state differs between runs
host CPU scheduling/background load changes submission overhead

measurement_plan: Interleave 074700-style and 081900-style runs in one session; alternate 5x each.
Record GPU core/memory clocks, board power, temperature and utilization at 1 Hz (AMD ADL/SMI or vendor tool).
Record whether the session is local console or RDP, and display power state.
Use one fresh session per sample and report per-sample distribution; do not compare different methods as if identical.
Keep all runs under new run_ids; never rewrite the historical benchmark receipts.

clocks.limitation: clocks only; APU ADL temperature/power/activity are NOT_SUPPORTED on this host, so they remain NOT_MEASURED

controlled_variants.conclusion: priority/profiling changes do not reproduce 2.56 ms; clocks stay 2900/1000 MHz
